title: 7. Publish a capability people can adopt

rows: Payment progress for authorised suppliers and service teams.
Eligibility, request route, example interaction and first-use test.
Data freshness, supported usage and known limitations.
Capability owner, producer contact and escalation route.
Version, change notice, migration and retirement policy.

elements.text: Publishing includes enablement and support, alongside technical access.

notes:
Canonical station: Capability Publishing & Enablement. Publish so intended consumers can discover, understand, request access, onboard, use and get support. Resources include publishing/discovery, consumer onboarding, service-agreement and versioning/lifecycle guides. Use a catalogue entry and service agreement appropriate to the selected style.

The supplier-payment status capability is a newly authored fictional teaching example, not a client implementation or measured outcome. Figures, service promises and release criteria are illustrative proposals requiring validation. Working summaries are not reproductions of canonical canvas templates.
